inspiration: Layered move feedback: one function decides a feedback tier from the event type. A plain move gets a light tap, a check gets a medium tap, and a capture goes to the capture sound (lib/src/service/move_feedback.dart lines 14-35). Keep the one-function map from event to tier; change the tiers to our hit (light), parry (medium) and finisher (heavy).

Three-channel punishment for a wrong move: an error sound, a heavy haptic and a time penalty, all in the same branch (lib/src/model/puzzle/storm_controller.dart lines 111-114). Keep the three channels together so one miss feels clear; change the penalty to guard loss and a short stagger.

Theme fallback per cue: a sound is looked up in the theme folder first and falls back to the standard folder if missing (lib/src/service/sound_service.dart lines 128-139). Keep the fallback so a sparse sound pack still plays every cue; change the base pack to our hit and block set.

Feature cues live in the base pack only (lib/src/service/sound_service.dart line 34). Keep the idea of a base pack that owns rare cues; use it for finisher and death stingers, which only the base pack needs.
One haptics switch gates every tier (lib/src/service/move_feedback.dart line 17). Keep a single accessibility toggle over all haptics; set the same switch for our phone build.

Material skin chips: 25 small jpg previews of board surfaces (assets/board-thumbnails/). A grid of small material swatches is a readable picker at phone width; keep the grid, use our own arena materials.

briefs.label: Three-channel wrong-move punishment
briefs.why: A miss hits sound, touch and a state change at once, so the player feels the cost even with the sound off.
briefs.keep: error cue + heavy haptic + a cost in the same branch
briefs.change: the cost is guard loss and a short stagger, not a clock penalty; the cue is a dull guard-break sound of our own

briefs.label: Tiered touch tap for moves and hits
briefs.why: Light, medium and heavy taps map to events of rising weight, so a crowd of hits stays readable by feel.
briefs.keep: a single mapping function from event to tap tier
briefs.change: tiers are hit, parry and finisher; the tap pattern and strengths are our own

briefs.label: Material swatch picker for arena surfaces
briefs.why: Small square material chips read at a glance at 375 wide and let the player choose a surface without text.
briefs.keep: grid of square swatches, one per material, with a selected ring
briefs.change: our own materials (sand, ash, ice, moss) and our own palette; no wood, marble or leather copies
